## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `SetupGuide`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `hubspot-crm-obj-schemas-setup-guide`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **SetupGuide**.

## Step 2: Create a HubSpot private app

1. <!-- manual: Log in to your HubSpot account. -->
2. Select **Settings** (gear) icon in the top navigation bar.
3. <!-- manual: In the left sidebar, navigate to Integrations → Private Apps. -->
4. Select **Create a private app**.
5. <!-- manual: Under the Basic Info tab, enter a name (e.g., Ballerina Schemas Connector) and an optional description for your app. -->

## Step 3: Configure scopes

1. Select **Scopes**.
2. <!-- manual: Search for and select the following scopes required by the Schemas API: -->
3. <!-- manual: crm.schemas.custom.read: read custom object schemas -->
4. <!-- manual: crm.schemas.custom.write: create, update, and delete custom object schemas -->
5. <!-- manual: Add any additional scopes your integration requires. -->

## Step 4: Create the app and copy the access token

1. Select **Create app** (top right). Review the scopes summary and confirm by clicking **Continue creating**.
2. <!-- manual: Review the scopes summary and confirm by clicking Continue creating -->
3. After the app is created, HubSpot displays your **Access token** on the app detail page.
4. Select **Show token** and copy the value. This is the Bearer token you will use to authenticate the connector.
